# thoth_agent_enforcement (Resource)

An agent's enforcement mode. In `observe` Thoth evaluates every action, records what enforcing would have decided (see the agent's observe summary) and allows it; in `enforce` decisions apply. Destroying this resource returns the agent to `enforce`, which is what every default policy does.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "thoth_agent_enforcement" "billing" {
  agent_id         = "billing-agent"
  enforcement_mode = "observe" # observe | enforce
  # high_risk_action = "deny"  # hold (default) | deny
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `agent_id` (String) The registered agent.
- `enforcement_mode` (String) `observe` (evaluate and record, allow everything) or `enforce` (decisions apply).

### Optional

- `high_risk_action` (String) While enforcing, what a high model risk score does: `hold` the action for approval (default) or `deny` it. Rules decide either way; a score can only make a decision stricter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Terraform resource identifier (agent ID).

## Import

```shell
terraform import thoth_agent_enforcement.billing <agent_id>
```
